LanguageData.Megamod.PotentialMood.Enabled: Consider potential mood for scheduled drugs
LanguageData.Megamod.PotentialMood.EnabledHelp: For scheduled drug use, require both current mood and potential mood from current thoughts to be below the policy's mood threshold. A 100% threshold or no mood need adds no restriction. Changes apply to the next selection and do not interrupt an existing order. Other drug rules still apply.
LanguageData.Megamod.PotentialMood.Unavailable: The scheduled mood restriction is unavailable. Native drug rules and any supported tolerance limit still apply.
LanguageData.Megamod.PotentialMood.ContextUnavailable: The scheduled mood restriction requires a fully loaded colony.
LanguageData.Megamod.PotentialMood.ReadingUnavailable: A current or potential mood value could not be read. This selection omits only the extra mood restriction; native drug rules and any supported tolerance limit still apply.
